references.title: Northeast lighthouse photograph
references.inspection: Viewed full photograph in browser. Ground door and base chamfer, taper, alternating shaft windows, black east stripe, two galleries, red service drum and lantern dome are visible. Office in background is excluded.
references.use: Geometry reference only; pixels are not embedded or redistributed.

sources.title: William Martinson architectural site description, December 2019
sources.facts: Measured base circumference 21.25 m. Round as-built tower; east door/daymark; staggered sash windows, projecting stone cornice, curved main-gallery balusters, 16-part lantern and 12-part dome. Unseen details are generalized.

sources.title: Robben Island Lighthouse Fact File
sources.facts: Tower approximately 18 m, white body and black east stripe, red lantern. Coordinate 18.374134,-33.814701 is near the mapped circular tower. Published focal-plane height is not used as a physical tower dimension.

sources.title: Robben Island Museum settlement history
sources.facts: Identifies the lighthouse on Minto Hill.

notes: Private modern photographs excluded from active imagery. Their former use remains historical provenance; current geometry comparison uses the dated public-domain postcard and independent factual architectural text.
